fields.System.Title: OUT-505 — Generate label and packing slip content
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a packer, I want the shipping label and packing slip content produced by the system,
so that a local print agent can produce them without anyone retyping an address.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a closed carton, then label content is generated with ship-to address, carton
  • reference, order reference, and weight.
  • - Given a packing slip, then product descriptions come from the order snapshot, not
  • from live master data.
  • - Given label generation, then the carton is marked as labelled and can no longer be
  • reopened — see [OUT-507](OUT-507-void-and-repack.md).
  • - Given a carrier, then the content includes the fields that carrier requires.
  • - Given the system, then it does not talk to a printer — it returns content only.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, masterdata |
| Tables | carton, order_line |
| Risks | Packing slip built from live master data differing from what was ordered ([doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
